data.name: Sinchan
data.gender_notes: Sinchan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings joy and happiness to others. The name Sinchan carries the meaning “Lord of Joy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sinchan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sinchan is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sinha', meaning 'lion'. This name is associated with the god Ganesha, who is known as the lord of happiness and remover of obstacles. Sinchan is a name that embodies the spirit of joy and happiness, and is believed to bring these qualities to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Sinchan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sinchan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

His commentaries and interpretations have been influential in Jaina philosophy and religious practices.

Sinchan Suri was a Rajput king of Marwar in the late 16th century. He ruled from 1541 to 1571 CE and is remembered for his military conquests and the construction of several temples and forts. Sinchan Suri is also known for his patronage of the arts, particularly the Jain literature, during his reign.
